summary: Both no-socket spawn tests assert full-list equality over every emitted tmux argv (and sha256-pin the shell pane command), so an implementation that adds `-f <cfg>`, a `source-file cfg ;` chain, or a separate `set-option`/`bind-key` call when tmux_socket=None is rejected; the real defaults_argv/new_session_argv helpers run unmocked and the only two no-socket session-creation paths (LocalRunner, ShellRunner) are both covered.
